stops.title: Wɛlfɛa ɛn Sefgadin
stops.caption: Tu inbɔks, sɛpret pɔposli.
stops.speech: Wɔri gɛt tu inbɔks. Wɛlfɛa ɛn sefgadin de sɛpret pɔposli, ɛn difrɛn pipul de rid dɛn.

stops.title: Fɔ Rid Wan
stops.caption: Di rɛkɔd, ɛn udat bring am.
stops.speech: If yu opin wan wɔri i de sho di fɔlo ɔp usay i kɔmɔt, udat bring am, ɛn wetin dɛn dɔn du bɔt am.
